brech: Stochastic Modelling of Infectious Disease Outbreaks

Source: R/brech-package.R
brech-package.Rd

The rapid construction and prototyping of stochastic infectious disease models in small (~100 individuals) to medium (~1000 individuals) size settings. Includes tools for defining model parameters, rates, and initial conditions along with model fitting and scenario projections. This ease of construction does come at the cost of computational efficiency and so would not be recommended for larger settings or with more complicated dynamics with multiple rates. Stochastic simulation is performed using the adaptive tau leaping algorithm Cao (2006) doi:10.1063/1.2745299 and model fitting is implemented using approximate Bayesian computation Kypraios (2017) doi:10.1016/j.mbs.2016.07.001 .
